crossRefs.note: The ropes of the wicked bind me, but I won’t forget your law.
The proud have smeared a lie upon me. With my whole heart, I will keep your precepts.
The proud have dug pits for me, contrary to your law.
He lies in wait near the villages. From ambushes, he murders the innocent. His eyes are secretly set against the…
When evildoers came at me to eat up my flesh, even my adversaries and my foes, they stumbled and fell.
The wicked watch the righteous, and seek to kill him.
They also who seek after my life lay snares. Those who seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and meditate deceits all…
Now therefore, O king, come down. According to all the desire of your soul to come down; and our part will be to…
Moreover Ahithophel said to Absalom, “Let me now choose twelve thousand men, and I will arise and pursue after David…
Then the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders of the people were gathered together in the court of the high…
When Peter had come to himself, he said, “Now I truly know that the Lord has sent out his angel and delivered me out of…
Therefore don’t yield to them, for more than forty men lie in wait for him, who have bound themselves under a curse to…
asking a favor against him, that he would summon him to Jerusalem; plotting to kill him on the way.
Indeed your statutes are my delight, and my counselors.
I cling to your statutes, Yahweh. Don’t let me be disappointed.
I have taken your testimonies as a heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.
I am your servant. Give me understanding, that I may know your testimonies.
Your testimonies are wonderful, therefore my soul keeps them.
My soul has observed your testimonies. I love them exceedingly.

translations.web: The wicked have waited for me, to destroy me. I will consider your statutes.
translations.bsb: The wicked wait to destroy me, but I will ponder Your testimonies.
translations.kjv: The wicked have waited for me to destroy me: but I will consider thy testimonies.
translations.asv: The wicked have waited for me, to destroy me; But I will consider thy testimonies.
